name: 07843 · Hopatcong, NJ
findings: ZIP 07843 (Hopatcong) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07843 (Hopatcong) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07843 (Hopatcong) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 27% of all organizations here have no identified type.
